interface.name: moko_window_manager_v1
interface.description: Exposes compositor-owned toplevel state to trusted clients in the same unprivileged desktop session. Requests operate only on enumerated window IDs and cannot launch commands or processes.

event.name: brightness_step

description.summary: request a bounded display brightness adjustment

event.description: Sent for compositor-owned hardware brightness key presses. A positive delta raises brightness and a negative delta lowers it.

request.name: set_natural_scroll

description.summary: change natural scrolling on compatible touchpads

request.description: Applies a bounded boolean setting only to compositor-managed libinput touchpads that support two-finger scrolling.

request.name: set_pointer_acceleration
request.description: The speed is expressed in thousandths and clamped by the compositor to the libinput range from -1000 to 1000.

event.name: input_config

description.summary: actual compositor touchpad capabilities and state

event.description: Reports aggregate state for detected libinput touchpads. Unsupported features are omitted rather than simulated.

request.name: set_output_scale

description.summary: set a bounded desktop output scale

request.description: Accepts only the compositor-supported integer percentages. The v0.1.1 implementation supports 100 and 200 percent and rejects other values.

request.name: set_keyboard_layout
request.description: Selects one of the keyboard_layout enum values. No arbitrary XKB rule, model, layout, variant or option string crosses this protocol.

request.name: set_shell_overlay

description.summary: show or dismiss the MOKO Shell overlay

request.description: Raises the already mapped MOKO Shell for bounded system surfaces such as Launcher and Notification Center, then restores the previous app.

event.name: desktop_config
event.description: Reports compositor-owned configuration after startup and after each accepted change. Scale capabilities reflect every connected output so a global scale cannot make the Shell smaller than its supported logical desktop size.

event.name: global_action

description.summary: request a fixed Shell-owned global action

event.description: Sent only for compositor-owned shortcuts. The action is a bounded enum and cannot contain a command, path or user-provided string.

request.name: prepare_shutdown

description.summary: fade every compositor output to black

request.description: Starts the compositor-owned shutdown blackout. This request has no arguments and cannot execute commands or alter system power state.

event.name: shutdown_blackout_presented

description.summary: the final black frame reached every output

event.description: Sent only after the compositor has committed an opaque black frame on every connected output. The session may then release its logind delay inhibitor after the required black hold interval.

request.name: set_gesture_enabled
request.description: Changes only allowlisted MOKO gestures. Unsupported gestures are rejected by the compositor and are never emulated in applications.

event.name: gesture_config

description.summary: actual compositor gesture capabilities and state

event.description: Reports gesture support from the detected libinput devices and the currently applied enablement state.
